summary: Macon County, NC: listed on the tnlandforms.us state tower list at 35.03, -83.26; no build, staffing or fate source found.
notes_for_editor: Only source is one row of the tnlandforms.us list. The row gives name, coordinates, county and a further code, but the list does not say the tower was built, staffed, stands today or is open. No Little Scaly page turned up in two searches or in the cached Forest Lookouts, NHLR, FFLOS or tnlandforms pages, and the Barr-based Toe River blog covers only Avery, Mitchell and Yancey counties. The story is a stub below the 120-word floor; the editor may prefer to hold it until a Macon County or NC Forest Service source turns up. Status and access stay unknown.
